follow-up time: Until discharge or development of complications
outcome: Surgical site infection (composite of cellulitis, endometritis, deep wound infection, abdominopelvic abscess, and sepsis)
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean delivery (n=6,584) excluding those with chorioamnionitis or who did not receive antibiotics
finding: Compared to cefazolin, both standard alternative and inappropriate alternative antibiotic regimens were associated with increased odds of surgical site infections after cesarean delivery.
